title: Deep learning-enabled assessment of cardiac allograft rejection from endomyocardial biopsies
study_context: Multicenter deep-learning assessment of cardiac transplant endomyocardial biopsy WSIs.
population_or_data: Development data from the United States and independent test cohorts from Turkey and Switzerland.
task: Detect, subtype, and grade cardiac allograft rejection and detect Quilty B lesions.
method: Gigapixel WSI deep learning with independent-cohort evaluation and a human reader study.
main_findings: The reported system detected rejection, ACR, AMR, Quilty B lesions, and high-versus-low grade rejection with task-specific AUCs.
Independent international cohorts introduced variation in population, preparation, and scanning.
limitations: The accessible publisher PDF is a print of the web article; local source locators use its PDF pagination.
Clinical efficacy still requires prospective clinical trials.
does_not_establish: The reported external validation does not establish transportability to the local SMC cohort, stains, scanners, or label definitions.
relevance_to_project: Closest published benchmark for cardiac allograft rejection from routine pathology slides.
